PARKED 2026-08-29 on DESKTOP-F82ORAK, repo bookSHelf @ desktop 529db1536

DOING: Re-authoring Integrated Math 1 Chapter 1 so its five sections share
one narrative instead of reading as five unrelated documents. Plan is
written and committed; NO manifest or prose edits made yet.

STATE (finished + verified):
- Diagnosis confirmed by measurement, not opinion. Every sections carrying
  context dies at its own boundary: border/checkerboard 90/16 hits in 1.1
  and 0 in 1.2-1.5; Growing Dots 17 in 1.2 and 0 elsewhere; bagel 25 in 1.2
  and 0 elsewhere; Sylvia 6 in 1.3 and 0 elsewhere. Four disposable casts,
  none recurring. All five problem sets are 100 percent intra-section.
- ROOT CAUSE 1: no pipeline stage has cross-section scope. layout-place
  assigns sources per heading, section-author welds within one section,
  remaster applies voice within one section. Nobody asks the chapter-level
  question.
- ROOT CAUSE 2 (the big one): book_manifest.yaml files mvp-m1 3.4 The Water
  Park and 3.5 Pooling it Together into Appendix C.6 -- a course cut that is
  never scheduled -- while section 1.4 Domain and Range is assigned ZERO mvp
  sources and was built entirely from OpenStax one-offs. Section 1.3 was
  assigned mvp-m1 3.2/3.3/3.6 and used none of them.
- Verified mvp-m1 has ZERO exponent material (0 hits for product/quotient
  property, zero/negative exponent, scientific notation) vs 202 in alg1 and
  261 in elem-alg. So 1.5 stays a context-free OpenStax outlier by design.
- Verified MVP READY/SET/GO is already a spaced-review device (Module 1 task
  4 READY topic is "use function notation to evaluate equations", four tasks
  before notation is taught). So we do NOT need CPMs copyrighted Review and
  Preview -- MVP ships the same thing CC BY 4.0.

WRITTEN, NOT YET ACTED ON:
docs/plans/2026-08-29-im1-chapter1-reauthor-source-contract.md (19KB)
Contains the per-book source contract (MVP = contexts, OpenStax = problems,
CPM = order only, mvp-m1-te = rationale/solutions, elem-alg = drill,
our-im1-u1 = structure only never prose), five manifest edits, a per-section
authoring spec for 1.1-1.5, the context-ledger design, and the
Review/Practice/Preview split.

NEXT: make the five manifest edits in
projects/Integrated Math 1/book_manifest.yaml, section 3 of the plan.
The user asked to see that diff before any authoring begins. Highest-value
edit is moving mvp-m1 3.4 and 3.5 from sn C.6 to sn 1.4. Also fix the stale
mapping table in SOURCES.md (says module 1 -> Ch 5, module 3 -> Ch 3;
correct is module 1 -> Ch 4, module 2 -> Ch 2/7, module 3 -> Ch 1).
Then re-author 1.4 FIRST, not 1.1.

WATCH:
- SHARED TREE. A concurrent session on this box committed ce0ee919c during
  this park. HANDOFF.md says in three places: git commit -- <explicit paths>,
  never git add -A. I committed only my one plan file. Left untouched and
  still dirty: _workspace/_metrics/{delegation,events,summary}.jsonl and
  three .agents/handoffs/HANDOFF-2026-08-2[46]-*.md. They are not mine.
- PUSH IS PUBLISH. desktop is production.
- The pre-push full suite ran past 9 minutes and my first push attempt was
  killed by the tool timeout without landing. Second attempt was launched
  detached. VERIFY origin/desktop actually carries 529db1536 before trusting
  the code travelled -- if it did not, the plan file is local-only and this
  note is the only thing that made it across.
- Correction carried forward: mvp-m1 tasks 1.4-1.7 (Scott, Chain, candy) are
  SEQUENCES material belonging to our Chapter 4, NOT available to 1.2. An
  earlier read in-session said otherwise and was wrong.

RUN:
  cd ~/Documents/GitHub/bookSHelf
  unset SSLKEYLOGFILE          # else pytest dies with no traceback

DOING: Integrated Math 1 chapter 1 re-author. Complete and deployed to a
Preview for review. NOT merged to desktop, so it is NOT live.

STATE (all verified, not just written):
- 5 sections re-authored -> numbered -> solutions -> math-verified -> built -> published

- gates green: freshness x5, smoke both themes, overflow at pre-existing

NEXT: operator reviews the preview. Two things were explicitly left to them:

  (b) read 1.4s ten new slides for teaching quality. They are cheap-model
      output verified for FIDELITY against the section (numbers/wording

WATCH:
- The pages.dev subdomain is bookshelf-9l4, NOT bookshelf. Guessing
  bookshelf.pages.dev gives a 404 branch alias. Use
  npx wrangler pages deployment list --project-name bookshelf.
- The index Slides column is 10.5rem with NO mobile collapse. Fine for a
  preview, fix before desktop.
- annotations_e2e.test.mjs guards port 8911 and fails loudly if anything
  is listening. Running the full suite and then pushing (the hook reruns
  it) left a stale listener and rejected the first push. Not flaky --
  that guard working. Check netstat for 8911 before pushing.
- Work parked off desktop gets redone: .agents/memory/active/
  feedback_work_parked_off_desktop_gets_redone.md. This branch is the
  only place the chapter exists. Merge it or a later session will rebuild it.
- 1.4s teacher decks: DEF_CLUSTERS in teacher_decks_im1_14.py is a claim
  about CONTENT, not numbers. A renumber silently merges two unrelated
  definitions and overflows the slide. There is now an assert for it.

DOING: Integrated Math 1 chapter 1 re-author. DONE and LIVE on production.

STATE: origin/desktop = 0a86be0df, suite 2622 passed / 9 skipped / 0 failed.
5 sections re-authored and published; 9 decks (5 self-paced, 1.2 preload,
1.4 discovery/preload/lecture); book index now has one deck <select> + Open
per row, every deck named by its teaching style. Preview branch deleted

NEXT (nothing is blocking; pick any):
1. Index Slides column is 10.5rem with NO mobile collapse. It is LIVE.
   Narrow viewports are cramped. scripts/workflows/publish.py, the
   .chapter-group li grid + .ch-slides rules.
2. Five ch1 pages are missing their section-intro prose. desktops emitter
   fix (7b06117c1) restores it and convert() emits it correctly, but

WATCH — two real defects found the hard way:
- annotations_e2e.test.mjs LEAKS its wrangler on port 8911. A suite run
  that passes leaves a listener; the NEXT run fails its own busy-port
  guard. That alternation rejected four pushes. It is NOT flaky. Workaround
  used: ANN_E2E_PORT=8914 git push. Real fix is the tests teardown.
- publish.py does not regenerate projects/<book>/html/*.html. See NEXT 2.

OTHER WORKTREES, all left alone and none of them mine:
  main checkout  -> fix/toc-prose-drop (merged; 1 untracked scratch dir)
  math-engine    -> feature/math-engine, 206 unmerged, CLEAN. Active
                    MyOpenMath port, 60/149 rows done. Do not delete.
  source-merge   -> feature/source-merge, 19 unmerged, 3 source PDFs
                    STAGED AND UNCOMMITTED by someone else.
  auth-prod      -> chore/studio-auth-prod, 2 unmerged
  backup/pre-squash-20260729, 215 unmerged, not checked out — the
    2026-07-29 squash safety net. Deliberate. Do not delete.
Remote trim done: deleted feat/annotation-persistence, fix/stylus-touch-action,
fix/toc-prose-drop, preview/2026-08-09, feature/im1-ch1-reauthor.
Local branches could not be trimmed — git refuses while a worktree holds them.

NOTE: another session published desktop mid-flight (a138958bd) while I was
pushing. I merged it rather than pushing past it. Expect that again.

PARKED 2026-09-01, repo bookSHelf @ desktop d176fd1bb (+ a1002d65e metrics chore)

DOING: IM1 section 1.2 was teaching Ch 4 material. Root cause found, fixed, and guarded.

STATE (all committed, tree clean, 9 commits unpushed at park time):
 - 28b2f38f0 spine fix. book_manifest had MVP module 1 lessons 1.3 (Growing,
   Growing Dots) and 1.8 (What Comes Next?) filed under our 1.2; they are now at
   4.1 and 4.3. layout_place.py gained `defer_to` so a unit bound for another
   chapter is APPENDED there instead of dropped (the skill used to say "Never
   relocate", which forced the bug). New scripts/workflows/source_ledger.py is
   the only cross-chapter view in the pipeline; source_ledger_test.py holds it.
 - d176fd1bb 1.2 de-named. Definitions 1.2.5 Arithmetic Pattern and 1.2.6
   Geometric Pattern removed, plus figure def_1.2.6, across 3 markdown tiers and
   BOTH html tiers. The adding-vs-multiplying CONTRAST stays -- only the naming
   went, which is what the section always promised on its own line 38.

NEXT: the two decks. Both still teach Definitions 1.2.5 and 1.2.6 that the page
no longer has, and the 4 pdf/pptx exports with them. deck-bookshelf pass:
docs/integrated-math-1/chapter-1-functions/decks/1.2_representing_a_growing_pattern{,.teacher-preload}.bookshelf.html
 - cut the "Definitions 1.2.5 & 1.2.6" slide
 - footers 39->38 (student) and 36->35 (teacher-preload)
 - ~33 verdicts: "Geometric, ratio 2" -> "Grows by multiplying, constant ratio 2"
 - Key Terms "Nine words" -> seven; drop the arithmetic/geometric entries
 - remove the inline def_1.2.6 SVG
 - then export_deck_shots.mjs to regenerate the 4 binaries

WATCH:
 - PUSH MAY NOT HAVE LANDED. .githooks/pre-push runs the full suite and
   annotations_e2e.test.mjs has been red on a workerd crash-loop since 2026-08-31.
   Check `git log origin/desktop -1` before assuming the code travelled. If it is
   not there, the work is in these 3 commits locally on the other box only.
 - .gitignore now uses `projects/Integrated Math 1/merge/review/*` (star) with two
   negations. A directory-form ignore cannot be negated per-file, and
   source_splits.json must travel or source_ledger_test.py goes red on a fresh clone.
 - 9 of the 11 baselined interleaves are marked "grandfathered, NOT reviewed on
   their merits". Do not cite them as verified.
 - def_1.2.6 SVG is still on disk at svg-figures/integrated-math-1/def_1.2.6-geometric-pattern/
   and is a ready asset for 4.3, which now owns the MVP task its tables come from.

PARKED 2026-09-01 on HuffPalmer-PC2, repo bookSHelf @ desktop 6d63c3d26

DOING: Intro-to-Programming section 2.1.1 "the if statement" explainer video.

STATE: Done and verified. 1920x1080, 66.3s, voxcpm cloned narration, vertical
  flowchart. A/V drift 7ms, peak -1.6dB, 1989 frames. All gates green:
  register ok, grounding ok, clip CLEAN, motion PASS (7.9% frozen, longest
  1367ms vs 1600 budget), script fingerprint 720acc5a7ffef894 intact.
  Committed as 6d63c3d26 (5 files, all 2.1.1_*).

  NOT PUSHED. desktop IS production and push IS publish, so this commit is
  local to HuffPalmer-PC2 only. The new device will NOT see the 2.1.1 work
  until someone pushes. bookSHelf is 7 commits ahead of origin.

NEXT: decide whether to push (that publishes the video to the live domain).
  Then, optionally, the missing artifacts: this explainer ships NO dark pass
  and NO srt/vtt, while all five chapter-1 explainers have both (10 mp4s for
  5 explainers = light+dark pairs). The dark pass is cheap -- reuse this
  cut's audio and timeline per the explainer-video skill. Do NOT re-run
  explainer_timeline.py: voxcpm is non-deterministic and re-rolls all 17
  beats, which voids the A/V verification.

WATCH:
  - Do NOT use git add -A in bookSHelf. 10+ modified files there belong to
    OTHER live sessions (docs/script.js, Chapter_11 remastered md,
    yt_upload.mjs, jscad-run.js, deck_export_manifest.json). Use
    git commit -- <explicit paths> only. A bare commit after a scoped add
    takes the whole shared index, in both directions.
  - explainer_motion.mjs on this storyboard needs --ignore-after "~BOIL" or
    it reports a false 0% frozen on a cut that is really 7.9%.
  - The character is drawn on a canvas, so a DOM clip sweep cannot see him.
    It returned CLEAN on the exact frame that cut his head off the top. Read
    pixels for anything about him.
  - UNRESOLVED: ASR hears the payoff line (~50s) as "It steps straight over
    it" against the script's "It stepped". Four transcriptions agree, two
    with speech pre-roll. Needs a human ear, not another ASR pass. Fixing it
    costs a full re-synthesis, which re-rolls every beat.
  - HANDOFF.md is STALE. Its headline blocker -- section 1.4 reference deck
    parked, 2 failing tests, "do not fix by editing the tests" -- is CLOSED.
    The deck was rebuilt (53 slides, water park present, Definition 1.4.10
    present) and teacher_decks_discovery_leak_test.py is 8 passed.
  - feature/prog-ch10-13 has 12 unpushed commits in the .worktrees/im1-ch1
    worktree (Intro to Programming ch10-13, built and published).

RUN:
  unset SSLKEYLOGFILE          # or python dies with NO traceback (Norton)
  pytest                       # bare, from repo root. Never pytest tests/
  # For any render, TLS needs all three, or it exits 0 having written no mp4:
  #   export UV_SYSTEM_CERTS=1
  #   export SSL_CERT_FILE="$PWD/.tmp_ca.pem" REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE="$PWD/.tmp_ca.pem"
  # Build that bundle with ONE > , not two:
  #   cat $(python -c "import certifi;print(certifi.where())") \
  #       /c/ProgramData/Norton/Antivirus/wscert.pem > .tmp_ca.pem
  # Two redirects TRUNCATE Norton's cert file and it is not restorable by git.

CORRECTION to the PARKED note above. Read that one for the detail; this

- Still NOT PUSHED, and this is now bigger than one video. Pushing
